items.readable_text:
Content:
We can use benchmarks to estimate decimal subtraction.

Content:
For example, suppose we want to estimate the following difference using benchmarks with decimal parts of [MATH: 0.0] or [MATH: 0.5{:}]

Content:
[MATH: 12.53 - 7.17]

Content:
We first round both numbers to the nearest benchmark:

Content:
[MATH: 12.53|−|7.17; ↓|↓; 12.5|−|7.0]

Content:
Next, we calculate the difference:

Content:
[MATH: 1|2|.|5; −|7|.|0; 5|.|5]

Content:
Therefore, [MATH: 12.53 - 7.17] is approximately [MATH: 5.5,] which we can write as follows:

Content:
[MATH: 12.53 - 7.17 \approx 5.5]
